 Star rookie Caleb Wilson's status is up in the air when the Chicago Bulls face the San Antonio Spurs on Wednesday night.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Bulls' No. 4 overall pick was a surprise late addition to the team's injury report on Wednesday, when he was ruled 'questionable' with right hip soreness. During his pregame press conference, head coach Tiago Splitter could not confirm whether or not Wilson would play. Wilson will warm up and see how he feels, making him a game-time decision.
 "He started to feel some type of soreness, and we're just being precautious," Splitter said. "We've got to be smart with him. He's playing a lot of minutes. I think those minutes are good for his development, but we've also got to be smart with his body, being young. I think there's a false thought that when you're young, you can do whatever. That's not true. You've got to get stronger. Your body's got to be prepared and strong to face a season like the NBA. We've got to be careful there and we'll monitor, for sure."
 Chicago will also be without veteran shooting guard Norman Powell, who also missed Sunday's game with back spasms. Splitter said Powell is at "70%" and will likely return when the Bulls face the Atlanta Hawks on Friday.
 Here's everything you need to know before the Bulls take on the Spurs:
